description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate and strategic leader, passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and maintaining the highest standards of clinical excellence. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing care plans, managing nursing staff, and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and the success of our facility.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
